name: vibeview
stderr:
Usage: vibeview [options] [command]

VibeView CLI -- run your app on cloud iOS simulators, Android emulators, Apple
TV, Android TV and Roku devices: a React Native dev loop (dev), device control
for you or your coding agent (ui-tree, tap, mcp), and tests from CI (run-test,
run-suites)

Options:
  -V, --version                        output the version number
  -h, --help                           display help for command

Commands:
  run-suite [options] <suite-id>       Run all test cases in a suite
  run-suites [options]                 Run all suites matching a tag filter
  run-test [options] <test-id>         Run a single test case
  list-suites [options]                List available test suites
  list-apps [options]                  List apps in your organization
  list-builds [options] <app>          List an app's uploaded builds, newest
                                       first: id, version, platform,
                                       debug/release, upload time and note (the
                                       ids `dev --build <id>` and `run-test
                                       --build` take)
  list-devices [options]               List devices registered with the platform
                                       (filterable by type and category)
  upload-app [options] <file>          Upload an app build (zipped simulator
                                       .app for iOS/tvOS, .apk for
                                       Android/Android TV, or a Roku channel
                                       .zip)
  create-test [options] [name]         Create an AI test case, optionally in one
                                       or more groups
  import-maestro [options] <path>      Import Maestro flows as tests: a flow
                                       file, a .zip of your flows folder, or the
                                       folder itself
  login [options]                      Log in to VibeView (interactive)
  logout                               Revoke the saved login token and remove
                                       it from ~/.vibeview/config.json
  dev [options]                        Stream your app from the fleet with live
                                       Metro hot-reload (RN debug builds), or
                                       press `r` to re-package and reload a Roku
                                       channel in place
  build [options]                      Run your configured build command and
                                       upload the result (see vibeview.json)
  submit [options]                     Submit a succeeded production cloud
                                       build's artifact to TestFlight
                                       (ios/tvos), a Google Play track
                                       (android/androidtv), or Amazon Appstore
                                       review (android/androidtv with --store
                                       amazon). TestFlight: the upload, then
                                       VibeView sends the build to the
                                       TestFlight groups you name (--group;
                                       follow it with --wait-distribution).
                                       Google Play: the upload plus optional
                                       release notes; the listing and review
                                       stay in Play Console. --store amazon also
                                       writes the release notes and sends the
                                       version for Amazon review
  submissions                          Follow store submissions: list, status
                                       and logs, Check again and Stop following
                                       (TestFlight)
  testflight                           TestFlight settings and details for your
                                       apps
  builds                               Manage cloud builds (see `vibeview build
                                       --cloud`)
  versions
